## setting
**538 run(s)** — rule `ada21-PRJEB39201-setting` — 10.1186/s12864-021-07488-3  
*Methods, 'Generating the Pst expression browser'*

> To generate data for incorporation into the Pst expression browser we first used a set of 538 Pst-infected plant samples that were collected across 30 countries from 2014 to 2018 (Supplementary Table S1). Pst-infected wheat leaf samples were collected and initially stored in RNAlater solution to preserve nucleic acid integrity (Thermo Fisher Scientific, United Kingdom) as previously described. ... To further expand this initial dataset, we also identified a total of 486 RNA-Seq datasets from four previously published Pst infection time-courses (66 datasets) and Pst-infected plant field samples (420 datasets).

## sampling_selection
**538 run(s)** — rule `ada21-PRJEB39201-sampling_selection` — 10.1186/s12864-021-07488-3  
*determination over the paper's own description of the cohort*

> Every sample in this compendium is described by the authors as 'Pst-infected': the cohort exists because the plants were showing yellow rust, collected under an explicit surveillance programme ('field pathogenomics', ev-ada21-surveillance). The sampling therefore conditioned on disease. This is the strongest available test of the cryptic co-infection hypothesis, because the authors reported Pst and only Pst, so any further pathogen in the reads is unreported by construction. It is simultaneously unusable as a prevalence denominator, for the same reason. Lab rows are marked 'inoculated' rather than 'disease-selected': there an archived isolate was deliberately applied to wheat, so disease is present by the experimenter's design, not by the sampler's choice.

## location
**537 run(s)** — rule `ada21-PRJEB39201-location` — 10.1186/s12864-021-07488-3  
*Supplementary Table S1 (12864_2021_7488_MOESM1_ESM.xlsx), header at row 2*

> Per-sample table, 1,024 rows: Study, Sample IDs, Date Isolated, Host Species, Host Variety, Location, Country, Collector, Accession Code, Sample Type. Sample Type is Field 939 / Lab 85 / None 1, and Location is town-level for most field rows (Ickleton, Caythorpe, Wardington, Sinana) with only 0.5% unknown. The sheet footnotes the date column: 'Pst-infected samples from Pst isolates initially found prior to 2013 were inoculated onto wheat under laboratory conditions (date shown represents the initial isolation).' The date is therefore a COLLECTION date for Field rows only, and ada21_runs.py REFUSES to write unless every Lab row is pre-2013 and every Field row 2013 or later, which currently holds with no exceptions. Keyed by Accession Code, an ENA secondary sample accession (ERS) for the five PRJEB studies and a run accession for the SRA ones; ada21_runs.py resolves ERS to run through the ENA portal and emits the Run-keyed table these rules join against.
